sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-3d"
sources.quote: K2-3d, also known as EPIC 201367065 d, is a confirmed exoplanet of probable mini-Neptune type orbiting the red dwarf star K2-3, and the outermost of three such planets discovered in the system.

introduction.text: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-3. Its orbit and size follow Diamond-Lowe et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: It is located 143 light-years away from Earth in the constellation of Leo.
